events.title: MTV turns 45
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's 45th
angles.copy: 45 years ago today, MTV changed the game. Remember the exact moment "Video Killed The Radio Star" kicked off a new era for music?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994, featuring iconic tracks like "Live Forever" and "Supersonic".

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as fresh and vital as day one. What's your top track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. A truly iconic moment in history.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders and an absolute icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam tune?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut with 'Dr. No' back in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.
